_note: Known, real findings the guard must not hide and cannot fix by itself. Every entry is a credential that was PUBLISHED on a public repo and still needs rotating. `lib/secrets-guard.test.js` fails on anything not listed here; it prints every entry whose status is not `rotated` on every run, and `--strict` fails on them too. Delete an entry only after the credential is rotated AND the blob is gone from history.

historyPaths.why: A Netscape jar for suno.com was committed in cd434e4 and deleted in dec6892. Deleting it did not unpublish it: the blob is still readable in the history of a PUBLIC repo. `__client` is Clerk's long-lived refresh token, so the exposure outlives the short session JWT.
historyPaths.action: Sign out of suno.com everywhere (this revokes __session and __client), then re-mint ~/.suno-cookies.txt. To close the public read, purge the blob from history (git filter-repo + force-push) — that rewrites a public repo, so it is the owner's call. GitHub secret scanning will not help: it does not recognise this shape.
